name: portfolio-cms-fullstack
description: Fullstack Portfolio & Custom CMS built with Vite, React, Tailwind CSS, Express, and PostgreSQL

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
